description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {10}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Put the tapped Chromatic Orrery into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery copy by tapping it, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
